Subject: Streamlining STAT Pathology and Blood Specimen Transit with HealthRoute Logistics

Dear Dr. Marcus Vance,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Divine Johns, and I am the CEO of HealthRoute Logistics, a leading provider of same-day HIPAA-compliant medical courier services. I am reaching out to discuss how our services can significantly enhance the efficiency and reliability of STAT pathology and blood specimen transit at Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center.

At HealthRoute Logistics, we understand the critical importance of timely specimen delivery in healthcare settings. Our Charlotte-based service offers a 45-minute STAT dispatch, ensuring that your specimens are transported with the utmost urgency and care. We maintain a temperature-controlled chain of custody to ensure the integrity of your specimens, regardless of their sensitivity.

One of the features that sets us apart is our flat rate of $85 per STAT run. This transparent pricing model allows you to predict and manage your transportation costs more effectively, without the hidden fees often associated with other services.

We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service and reliability. Our team of experienced couriers is dedicated to your needs, ensuring that your specimens arrive at their destination on time and in perfect condition.

I would be delighted to discuss how our services can be integrated into your current operations and provide a personalized demonstration of our capabilities. Please feel free to contact me at 704-555-0199 or email me directly at divine@healthroutelogistics.com to schedule a call or consultation.

Thank you for considering HealthRoute Logistics for your medical courier needs. I look forward to the opportunity to serve Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center and contributing to your commitment to excellence in patient care.

Best regards,

Divine Johns
CEO, HealthRoute Logistics
704-555-0199
divine@healthroutelogistics.com

workflowData.name: HealthRoute Loop 01: Medical Courier Outreach & Dispatch (WF-LT005-ACQUIRE)

parameters.jsCode:
// HealthRoute Charlotte Facilities Queue
const items = $input.all();
const incoming = items[0]?.json?.body || items[0]?.json;

if (incoming && incoming.name && incoming.contact_email) {
  return [{
    json: {
      id: incoming.id || 'manual-' + Date.now(),
      name: incoming.name,
      facility_type: incoming.facility_type || 'hospital',
      address: incoming.address || 'Charlotte, NC',
      contact_email: incoming.contact_email,
      contact_phone: incoming.contact_phone || '704-555-0100',
      decision_maker_name: incoming.decision_maker_name || 'Medical Director',
      decision_maker_title: incoming.decision_maker_title || 'Director of Clinical Logistics',
      specialty: incoming.specialty || 'STAT specimen transport',
      source: 'webhook_inbound'
    }
  }];
}

const facilities = [
  {
    id: 'fac-clt-001',
    name: 'Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center',
    facility_type: 'hospital',
    address: '1000 Blythe Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28203',
    contact_email: 'operations@atriumhealth.org',
    contact_phone: '704-355-2000',
    decision_maker_name: 'Dr. Marcus Vance',
    decision_maker_title: 'Director of Clinical Operations',
    specialty: 'STAT pathology and blood specimen transit'
  },
  {
    id: 'fac-clt-002',
    name: 'Novant Health Presbyterian Medical Center',
    facility_type: 'hospital',
    address: '200 Hawthorne Ln, Charlotte, NC 28204',
    contact_email: 'logistics@novanthealth.org',
    contact_phone: '704-384-4000',
    decision_maker_name: 'Sarah Jenkins',
    decision_maker_title: 'Logistics and Materials Manager',
    specialty: 'Urgent lab sample transport between satellite clinics'
  },
  {
    id: 'fac-clt-003',
    name: 'Charlotte Surgery Center',
    facility_type: 'surgery_center',
    address: '1740 S Sterling St, Charlotte, NC 28203',
    contact_email: 'admin@surgicalpartnersclt.com',
    contact_phone: '704-567-8900',
    decision_maker_name: 'Michael Chang',
    decision_maker_title: 'Surgical Center Administrator',
    specialty: 'Surgical tissue biopsies and refrigerated specimen courier'
  },
  {
    id: 'fac-clt-004',
    name: 'Tryon Medical Partners - Uptown Clinic',
    facility_type: 'clinic',
    address: '101 S Tryon St, Charlotte, NC 28202',
    contact_email: 'intake@tryonmedclt.com',
    contact_phone: '704-522-1234',
    decision_maker_name: 'Brenda Holloway',
    decision_maker_title: 'Practice Operations Manager',
    specialty: 'Daily scheduled lab specimen runs to testing centers'
  },
  {
    id: 'fac-clt-005',
    name: 'Eastside Urgent Care & Diagnostic Center',
    facility_type: 'urgent_care',
    address: '3500 Wade Ave, Charlotte, NC 28205',
    contact_email: 'dispatch@medcathclt.org',
    contact_phone: '704-335-5000',
    decision_maker_name: 'David Ross',
    decision_maker_title: 'Clinical Lab Coordinator',
    specialty: 'STAT rapid culture pickups and temperature-monitored courier'
  }
];

return facilities.map(f => ({ json: { ...f, source: 'charlotte_facility_queue' } }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ statements: [{ statement: 'MERGE (f:Facility {name: $name}) ON CREATE SET f.id = $id, f.type = $facility_type, f.email = $email, f.city = "Charlotte", f.state = "NC" MERGE (o:OutreachAttempt {campaign: $campaign, timestamp: $dispatched_at}) SET o.subject = $subject, o.status = "dispatched", o.expected_revenue = $expected_revenue, o.model = $model MERGE (f)-[:RECEIVED_OUTREACH]->(o) WITH f, o MATCH (v:Venture {id: "LT-005"}) MERGE (v)-[:LOGGED_OUTREACH]->(o) RETURN o.status', parameters: { name: $json.facility_name, id: $json.facility_id, facility_type: $json.facility_type, email: $json.recipient_email, campaign: $json.campaign, dispatched_at: $json.dispatched_at, subject: $json.subject, expected_revenue: $json.expected_revenue, model: $json.model_used } }] }) }}
